title: A Computationally Efficient Multidimensional Vision Transformer
summary: Vision Transformers have achieved state-of-the-art performance in a wide range of computer vision tasks, but their practical deployment is limited by high computational and memory costs. In this paper, we introduce a novel tensor-based framework for Vision Transformers built upon the Tensor Cosine Product (Cproduct). By exploiting multilinear structures inherent in image data and the orthogonality of cosine transforms, the proposed approach enables efficient attention mechanisms and structured feature representations.
